rules.rule: One syllable: **+er / the +est** — *old → older → the oldest*. Ending in -e: *nice → nicer → the nicest*.
examples: My car is older than yours.
This is the nicest café in town.

rules.rule: One vowel + one consonant: **double the consonant** — *big → bigger → the biggest*.
examples: Your bag is bigger than mine.

rules.rule: Two or more syllables: **more / the most** — *more interesting, the most beautiful*.
examples: This book is more interesting than that one.

rules.rule: Irregular: **good → better → the best**, **bad → worse → the worst**, **far → further → the furthest**.
examples: It was the worst day ever!
